title: Engineering On-Call Rotation
body: Engineering on-call rotates weekly, Monday to Monday. This week's primary: Marcus Webb. Secondary escalation: Priya Natarajan. To page the on-call engineer, use the #eng-oncall Slack channel or the PagerDuty escalation policy 'Engineering Primary'. The rotation covers payments-service, checkout-service, and the shared platform services; product-specific teams (Commerce, Growth) maintain their own secondary rotations for non-platform incidents.
